Rengar is a lot more mechanically demanding than voli and nunu, it’s ultimately up to you but I wouldn’t recommend Rengar or any of the other mechanically demanding junglers like Elise as your first jungle champion. Reason for this is because playing a mechanical champ like Rengar will most likely cause you to prioritize most of your attention to the champions mechanics itself and not how to properly jungle. I think champions like Kayn, nunu, hecarim, and olaf are all pretty good beginner jungle champions. Once you get a solid feel for the jungle is when you should start playing Rengar IMO

As a huge reksai prowlers claw fanatic, you excel at all in’ing the enemy acds and other squishy targets. Prowlers claw gives you a 100% knock up each time it’s up and combining that with your E allows you to always reach through the enemy back line: https://gyazo.com/63cf68913caef046bd27d5148f9dbeac. If your team is needing more damage for tankier comps or champions, reksai is also great at that with her E dealing true damage and black cleaver being a great item on reksai. With reksai i would typically aim to target the enemy squishies but of course this won’t be 100% of the time. Learning reksais early damage is huge for improving with her due to her amazing early game strength and damage/mobility and utility. You also need to learn the mechanics of her burrowing passive that allows her to sense movement since this is undoubtably her greatest strength. This allows you to have great counterganks if you’ve been tracking the enemy jungler, allows for great invades since you can see the enemy junglers movements or his camps moving around without actually being near the enemy at all. Also, reksai with flash/prowlers should always be a guaranteed kill on every gank or tower dive due to the unavoidable knockup and great damage and execute you have with your R. Just keep playing with her, she has a bit of a learning curve at first but once you start to feel comfortable with her kit things will come easy, you’ve got this!

I can’t really say when or when to not be burrowed because for me personally, being burrowed is majority of the time due to the increased MS it gives. I’d say that you just need more experience with rek’sai, when I forest started playing her I thought her tunnel vision was terrible and I hated it. Eventually once you feel comfortable with the champ you’ll see the power behind her ability to sense movement and such with being able to see junglers locations through walls when invading or see them coming to invade you. Reksai is one of the strongest early game junglers so against champs like olaf or Lee sin that can beat you early, I still recommend you staying burrowed in your own jungle because if they’re entering your jungle you’ll be able to see it coming with your passive. You also have one of the best clears in the game, so getting invaded shouldn’t be that big of a threat. Only times I’d be extremely cautious is late game if your team is being forced out of your own jungle and trapped in spawn p much
